title: Shows code blocks that retain indentation
goal: uses pre and code to display multiple lines of code, retaining the line breaks and indentation in the example.
summary: The web page preview displays several lines of code side by side. Mark the examples so readers can see which lines are inside the braces.
tasks: Replace the p outside the example with pre and mark the existing code with code within pre.
Keep the three lines of the example and the two spaces at the beginning of the second line, and continue to use < to represent the less than sign.

example.note: pre retains newlines and leading spaces, code marks code content. Use < and > to let readers see the angle brackets of a label.

hint: When using only code, the browser will still merge normal whitespace. Put code into pre and have the first line immediately after the code opening tag.
